def decide(observation, memory):
    """Run a conservative finite-state controller with safety gating, target
    confirmation, brief bearing smoothing, and turn hysteresis to reduce
    unnecessary oscillation while preserving the exact action interface.
    """
    memory = dict(memory or {})
    state = memory.get("state", "IDLE")
    scan_direction = memory.get("scan_direction", "SCAN_LEFT")
    last_turn = memory.get("last_turn", "")
    smoothed_bearing = float(memory.get("smoothed_bearing", 0.0))

    visible = bool(observation["target_visible"])
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    distance = observation["target_distance_class"]
    target_confidence = float(observation["target_confidence"])
    identity_confidence = float(observation["target_identity_confidence"])
    track_age = int(observation["track_age"])
    lost_steps = int(observation["lost_steps"])
    safety_confidence = float(observation["safety_confidence"])
    closing_risk = float(observation["closing_risk"])

    if safety_confidence < 0.60 or closing_risk >= 0.75:
        memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
        return "STOP", 0.99, memory

    confirmed = (
        visible
        and target_confidence >= 0.55
        and identity_confidence >= 0.60
    )

    if not confirmed:
        if state in {"LOCKED", "APPROACH", "REACQUIRE"} or lost_steps > 0:
            memory["state"] = "REACQUIRE"
            if lost_steps <= 1:
                return "STOP", 0.92, memory
        memory["state"] = "SEARCH"
        memory["scan_direction"] = (
            "SCAN_RIGHT" if scan_direction == "SCAN_LEFT" else "SCAN_LEFT"
        )
        return scan_direction, 0.75, memory

    if track_age < 2:
        memory["state"] = "VERIFY"
        return "SLOW_DOWN", 0.80, memory

    smoothed_bearing = 0.65 * smoothed_bearing + 0.35 * bearing
    memory["smoothed_bearing"] = round(smoothed_bearing, 3)
    memory["state"] = "LOCKED"

    if distance == "near":
        if (
            abs(float(observation["heading_error"])) <= 15.0
            and identity_confidence >= 0.80
        ):
            memory["state"] = "ARRIVED"
            return "ARRIVED", 0.96, memory

        memory["state"] = "APPROACH"
        turn = "VEER_LEFT" if smoothed_bearing < 0 else "VEER_RIGHT"
        memory["last_turn"] = turn
        return turn, 0.88, memory

    memory["state"] = "APPROACH"
    left = bool(observation["corridor_left"])
    right = bool(observation["corridor_right"])
    center = bool(observation["corridor_center"])

    if smoothed_bearing <= -15.0 and left:
        memory["last_turn"] = "VEER_LEFT"
        return "VEER_LEFT", 0.90, memory
    if smoothed_bearing >= 15.0 and right:
        memory["last_turn"] = "VEER_RIGHT"
        return "VEER_RIGHT", 0.90, memory

    if center and abs(smoothed_bearing) <= 15.0:
        return "FORWARD", 0.92, memory

    if center and abs(smoothed_bearing) <= 22.0:
        return "FORWARD", 0.86, memory

    if smoothed_bearing < 0 and left:
        memory["last_turn"] = "VEER_LEFT"
        return "VEER_LEFT", 0.84, memory
    if smoothed_bearing > 0 and right:
        memory["last_turn"] = "VEER_RIGHT"
        return "VEER_RIGHT", 0.84, memory

    if last_turn == "VEER_LEFT" and left:
        memory["last_turn"] = "VEER_LEFT"
        return "VEER_LEFT", 0.80, memory
    if last_turn == "VEER_RIGHT" and right:
        memory["last_turn"] = "VEER_RIGHT"
        return "VEER_RIGHT", 0.80, memory

    if left:
        memory["last_turn"] = "VEER_LEFT"
        return "VEER_LEFT", 0.78, memory
    if right:
        memory["last_turn"] = "VEER_RIGHT"
        return "VEER_RIGHT", 0.78, memory

    memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
    return "STOP", 0.98, memory
